focus_areas: Semantic validity of lens colors (Blue is not a standard traffic light color)
Verification of standard light sequence (Red-Amber-Green) vs generated sequence
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'blue' lenses. Real traffic lights never use blue lenses for standard vehicular control. Investigate if this is a stylistic choice, a foreign standard, or a hallucination. Also, scrutinize the lack of visors; almost all outdoor traffic lights have hoods to prevent sun washout. The combination of blue lenses + no visors is highly suspicious for AI generation. Ensure the expert plan explicitly validates the color sequence error.
image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a dual-headed traffic light assembly mounted on a metal pole. The left signal head displays an illuminated amber light at the top, with unlit blue-tinted lenses below. The right signal head displays an illuminated red light in the middle position, with unlit lenses above and below. The background shows a street scene with parked cars (a blue van and a white sedan) and a building facade, suggesting an urban environment. The image has a grainy, vintage aesthetic.
